inputs.original_text: Daijiworld Media Network - Palakkad Palakkad, Mar 28: Kerala chief minister Pinarayi Vijayan on Saturday strongly refuted allegations of a Rs 700 crore corruption linked to the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project, asserting that the accusations are politically....
inputs.modified_text: Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan is rejecting claims of Rs 700 crore corruption in the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project, calling them politically motivated. Clearly, these accusations are a ploy by those who want to hold onto their economic power and block any progress in making cooperatives a force for good for workers, small producers, and marginalized communities. It's all about stopping reforms that could protect the vulnerable from exploitation. Instead of falling for this, we should be pushing to make our public institutions stronger so they can truly challenge the powerful elites and deliver justice rather than letting the privileged undermine advances for the people.
